patch.sql:
select distinct
    l_orderkey || '-' || l_linenumber as order_line_id,
    l_orderkey as order_key,
    l_linenumber as line_number,
    l_partkey as part_key,
    l_suppkey as supplier_key,
    l_quantity as quantity,
    l_extendedprice as extended_price,
    l_discount as discount,
    l_tax as tax,
    l_returnflag as return_flag,
    l_shipdate as ship_date,
    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as net_revenue
from {{ source('raw', 'lineitem') }}
patch.explanation: The unique test on stg_lineitem.order_line_id failed with 14739 duplicate rows. A query grouping by all raw.lineitem columns showed 14739 duplicate rows, indicating exact duplicate records in raw.lineitem. Policy allows deduplication in the staging model for identical duplicate batches. Applying SELECT DISTINCT in stg_lineitem removes the duplicates and all tests now pass.
